Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Shelnutt
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/04/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 67 as introduced codifies the existing rule of the Peace Officers' Standards and Training Commission allowing graduation from a nonpublic education program as qualifying education to apply to become a law enforcement officer. This bill will not affect state or local funding.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Gray
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 99 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons that violate the prohibitions related to electric bicycles provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
